    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))

    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + np.log2(f.edge_padded_work_ratio) * w[0]
        s = s + np.log2(f.cta_wave_tail_ratio) * w[1]
        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[2]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(f.edge_padded_work_ratio) * w[3]

        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[7]

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + f.log_roofline_time_mraster * w[0]
    s = s + f.coalescing_aspect_penalty * w[1]
    s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[2]
    s = s + np.log2(f.accumulator_tile_bytes) * w[7]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1.0:
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[3]
        s = s + f.raster_reuse_distance_l2_ratio * w[4]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[8]
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[9]
    else:
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[5]
        s = s + f.instruction_density * w[6]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[10]
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[11]
    return s
